value.behaviour: Adds a TSDoc block above each of the eight static methods of `KubernetesValidatorFunctions`, stating the format each accepts.
rules: Each block is indented 2 spaces and sits directly above the `static` line: the summary text given in the site's rule, a ` *` line, then ` * @param value - The value to check`.

A DNS subdomain, as used below, means what `CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidDnsSubdomain` accepts: 1 to 253 characters of DNS labels separated by `.`; write it as `a valid DNS subdomain` in the comments.
No blank line outside the comment blocks is added; the methods stay as they are.

sites.rule: Summary: Checks that the value is a valid API version, on the form `<version>` or `<group>/<version>`. The `<group>` part must be a valid DNS subdomain, and the `<version>` part must be 1 to 63 characters of `[a-zA-Z0-9]`. Returns false for values that are not strings or that contain more than one `/`.

Summary: Checks that the value is a valid kind: a string of 1 to 63 characters that starts with a letter from `[a-zA-Z]` and continues with characters from `[a-zA-Z0-9]`. Returns false for values that are not strings.

Summary: Checks that the value is a valid object name: a string of 1 to 63 characters from `[a-zA-Z0-9]`, `-`, `_` and `.`, that starts and ends with a character from `[a-zA-Z0-9]`. Returns false for values that are not strings.

Summary: Checks that the value is a valid namespace, which is a DNS label: a string of 1 to 63 characters made of sequences of `[a-z0-9]` separated by one or more `-`, so it cannot start or end with `-`. Returns false for values that are not strings.

Summary: Checks that the value is a valid label key, on the form `<name>` or `<prefix>/<name>`. The `<prefix>` part must be a valid DNS subdomain, and the `<name>` part must be a valid object name as checked by `isValidObjectName`. Returns false for values that are not strings or that contain more than one `/`.
Summary: Checks that the value is a valid label value: either the empty string, or a valid object name as checked by `isValidObjectName`. Returns false for values that are not strings.

Summary: Checks that the value is a valid annotation key, on the form `<name>` or `<prefix>/<name>`. The `<prefix>` part must be a valid DNS subdomain, and the `<name>` part must be a valid object name as checked by `isValidObjectName`. Returns false for values that are not strings or that contain more than one `/`.
Summary: Checks that the value is a valid annotation value, which is any string, including the empty string. Returns false for values that are not strings.

sites.rule: Summary: Sets the namespace of the entity, if it has none. If `metadata.namespace` is set, the input entity is returned as is. Otherwise a new entity object is returned, a deep merge of the input over a `metadata.namespace` set to the namespace given to the constructor (`default` when none was given), and the input is not modified.

sites.rule: Summary: Checks the format of the envelope fields with the validators given to the constructor (the `makeValidator` defaults when none were given). The `apiVersion`, `kind` and `metadata.name` fields are required, `metadata.namespace` is checked when present, and every key and value of `metadata.labels` and `metadata.annotations` and every entry of `metadata.tags` is checked. Each entry of `metadata.links` needs a valid `url`, and a non-empty `title` and `icon` when present; these link checks always use `CommonValidatorFunctions`. Returns the input entity unchanged when every check passes, and otherwise throws an error that names the first field that is missing, invalid or could not be validated.

sites.rule: Summary: Sets the parent of a group that has none. Entities whose `kind` is not exactly `Group` (the comparison is case-sensitive) and groups that already have a `spec.parent` are returned unchanged. Otherwise `spec.parent` is set to the parent entity ref given to the constructor, unless the group is that parent itself, and the same entity object is returned, so the input is modified in place.

sites.rule: Summary: Validates the entity envelope against the built-in entity JSON schema, which is compiled on first use. The schema covers the root fields and `metadata`, but not the kind-specific contents of `spec`. Returns the input entity unchanged when it is valid, and otherwise throws an error starting with `Malformed envelope` that names the location and message of the first schema error.
